adversarial.text: Small island territories are exactly what players reach for under 500,000 people, but many are not recognized at all and score 0 with no reason: Montserrat, Anguilla, Falkland Islands (Falklands), Saint Helena, Tokelau, Wallis and Futuna, Saint Barthelemy (St Barts), Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Pitcairn Islands, Norfolk Island, Martinique, Guadeloupe, Mayotte, Bonaire, Aland Islands. They also matter for d6q1/d6q2/d6q3 (tiny populations, areas and economies).
adversarial.suggestion: Add these to extras with reasons, e.g. {"name": "Montserrat", "reason": "Montserrat is a British Overseas Territory, so it doesn't count as a country here."}; {"name": "Falkland Islands", "aliases": ["Falklands", "Malvinas", "Islas Malvinas"]}; Martinique/Guadeloupe/Mayotte/Reunion: "an overseas department of France".
adversarial.resolution: Added these places with reasons; the player can try again. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Cook Islands (~15k people) and Niue (~2k) are natural answers here, and they are recognized, but the reason shown is "not covered by World Bank data". That suggests they would count if the data existed. The actual rule is that they are self-governing states in free association with New Zealand and not UN members. The same misleading reason text is used for Vatican City, Taiwan and Western Sahara.
adversarial.suggestion: Reword the notInDataset reasons by the actual rule: "Cook Islands is in free association with New Zealand and isn't a UN member state, so it doesn't count here." (same for Niue); Vatican City: "a UN observer state, not a UN member"; Taiwan: "not a UN member state"; Western Sahara: "a disputed territory, not a UN member state".
adversarial.resolution: Reasons now name the real rule (not a UN member state). Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Typo tolerance is computed from min(name length, typed length), so dropping a letter from a 5-letter name gives a 4-letter input with zero tolerance. Players typing 'Palu', 'Naru', 'Smoa' or 'Tona' (for Palau, Nauru, Samoa, Tonga, all valid here) get unrecognized. The same goes for 'Chna'/'Inda' (d5q5, d7q1), 'Egyt', 'Japn', 'Qatr' and so on. The game promises forgiveness for names of 5+ letters.
adversarial.suggestion: In match.js base the tolerance on the canonical name's length (typoTolerance(n.length)) rather than Math.min(n.length, typed.length), or at least allow 1 edit when the canonical name has 5+ letters.
adversarial.resolution: Typo tolerance now follows the real name's length. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Australia (life expectancy ~83) is one of the most obvious answers for an 'island country' with life expectancy over 80, and it is commonly called an island continent/country. It is rejected with 'Australia isn't an island country.' The group notes explain Denmark/Malaysia/etc. but say nothing about Australia.
adversarial.suggestion: Add to the island-nations notes and show as the reason: "Australia is a continent, not an island, so it doesn't count here." Better still, put it in the prompt ('...island country (Australia doesn't count)...') so players aren't caught out on their only guess.
adversarial.resolution: Australia now shows "Australia is a continent, not an island country." (still a wrong answer). Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are not recognized at all (no alias, no extra). Many players will type 'England' for an island country with life expectancy over 80, and it scores 0 as unrecognized input.
adversarial.suggestion: Add "England", "Scotland", "Wales", "Northern Ireland" as aliases of GBR (scored as United Kingdom), or at minimum as extras with reason "England is part of the United Kingdom - answer United Kingdom."
adversarial.resolution: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are recognized and point to United Kingdom; the player can try again. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Taiwan (life expectancy ~81) is widely regarded as an island country and is a strong answer here (also for d5q1-d5q4). It is rejected with the reason 'Taiwan is not covered by World Bank data'. Nothing in the prompt or label tells the player that only UN member states count.
adversarial.suggestion: State the rule where players see it (e.g. label 'an island UN member state' or a one-line 'UN member states only' in the help/prompt), and change the reason to "Taiwan isn't a UN member state, so it doesn't count here."
adversarial.resolution: Taiwan shows that it isn't a UN member state, and the player can try again. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: 'Republic of Ireland' and 'Eire' are not recognized (too far from 'Ireland' for typo tolerance). Ireland is a top answer here (life expectancy ~82).
adversarial.suggestion: Add aliases to IRL: "Republic of Ireland", "Eire", "Éire".
adversarial.resolution: Added aliases Republic of Ireland and Eire. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Famous sub-national islands are unrecognized: Hawaii (life expectancy ~80+), Tasmania, Sicily, Sardinia, Corsica, Crete, Bali, Zanzibar, Canary Islands. Players get 0 with no explanation.
adversarial.suggestion: Add extras with reasons such as "Hawaii is a US state, so it doesn't count as a country here." and "Sicily is part of Italy...".
adversarial.resolution: Added famous sub-national islands with reasons; the player can try again. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.

adversarial.text: Cuba is in the group but has no figure, so a player typing it (a natural 'poorer island country' answer) gets 0 with 'Cuba has no figure for this in the source data.' adversarial.suggestion: Either fill missing values from a second source (UN/IMF estimates), or treat a noData answer as a free retry rather than a spent guess, or list the excluded countries under the prompt ('No data: Cuba').
adversarial.resolution: Countries without a figure now let the player try again. Covered by tests/content.test.mjs.
